facts.claim: [Lake Como, nearest official station: Milan] The WMO World Weather Information Service gives Milan climatological normals for 1971-2000, supplied by the Italian Air Force Department of Meteorology: August mean daily minimum 17.6 C, mean daily maximum 28.5 C, mean total rainfall 88.8 mm, mean number of rain days 7.1. Milan is a city station, not on Lake Como itself. The page does not state the rain-day threshold in the figures supplied to this batch [[VERIFY: au_c | Milan rain-day definition (0.1 mm or 1 mm) as stated in the page remarks]].

[Portugal: Lisbon] The WMO World Weather Information Service page for Lisboa, supplied by the Instituto Portugues do Mar e da Atmosfera (IPMA), gives August mean daily minimum 17.7 C, mean daily maximum 27.9 C, mean total rainfall 5.7 mm and mean number of rain days 2.0. The page remarks state the climatological information is based on monthly averages for the 30-year period 1961-1990, and that a rain day is a day with at least 0.1 mm of rain.

[France: Riviera, Nice] The WMO World Weather Information Service page for Nice, supplied by Meteo-France, gives August mean daily minimum 20.0 C, mean daily maximum 27.2 C, mean total precipitation 23.9 mm and mean number of precipitation days 2.9. The page remarks state the period is 1971-2000 and that a precipitation day is a day with at least 1 mm of precipitation. September at the same station shows 75.6 mm and 4.4 precipitation days.

[Mauritius: Port Louis] The WMO World Weather Information Service page for Port Louis, supplied by Mauritius Meteorological Services, gives August mean daily minimum 19.1 C, mean daily maximum 26.8 C, mean total precipitation 19.0 mm and mean number of precipitation days 5.0. The page remarks state the period is 1971-2000 and that a precipitation day is a day with at least 1 mm of precipitation. January at the same station shows a mean daily maximum of 31.5 C and 131.0 mm.

Every WMO World Weather Information Service city page checked in this batch carries the remark that the averaging period and the definition of rain or precipitation days may differ between countries, so care should be taken when city climatologies are compared.

insider_details.detail: Of the four stations in this batch, Lisbon has the driest August on paper (5.7 mm, 2 rain days, 1961-1990 normals), so an outdoor ceremony there needs a shade and heat plan more than a wet-weather plan. Still book a rain option, because normals are averages, not guarantees.

Nice has the warmest August nights of the European stations here (mean minimum 20.0 C), so evening receptions on the Riviera rarely need heaters, but guests in formal wear will feel it at dinner. Plan fans and cold water stations.

Milan records 88.8 mm and 7.1 rain days in August, far wetter than Lisbon or Nice. For Lake Como, treat a covered terrace or marquee as essential, not optional, and note Milan is a city station, not the lake itself.

August is Mauritius's cooler, drier season (Port Louis mean maximum 26.8 C versus 31.5 C in January), which suits Australian couples who want a tropical setting without peak heat. With about five precipitation days, keep a sheltered backup for the ceremony.

Do not compare rain-day counts across countries as like for like: Lisbon counts days with 0.1 mm or more, while Nice and Port Louis count days with 1 mm or more, and the base periods differ (1961-1990 versus 1971-2000).
